status: post-review sensitivity, not preregistered; specification fixed before computing any adjusted result with building type and style; earlier results (original direction, period+area) were known

inputs.metadata: export image_metadata.csv (period, continent[=area], building_type, architectural_style) as recorded
inputs.preprocessing: identical to the frozen file: L2-normalised CLS; no re-extraction; same 600 photographs, same 192 cells, same 7 adapters (REP-AES-S1254-R excluded as determinism re-run)

metadata_coding.area: continent field as recorded, 8 labels, no merging
metadata_coding.building_type: catalogue strings normalised only by trimming and lower-casing (236 -> 236 distinct; 182 singletons); categories with at least 3 photographs among the 600 get their own dummy (35 categories, 380 photographs); all others pooled into one 'rare type' level (220 photographs). No manual merging of aliases (museum/art museum etc. remain distinct): declared limit
metadata_coding.architectural_style: same normalisation (206 -> 205 distinct; 131 singletons); categories with at least 3 photographs get a dummy (41 categories, 403 photographs); others pooled into 'rare style' (197 photographs)
metadata_coding.overlap_A_vs_C: building type: 49 vs 47 categories, 27 shared; style: 46 vs 52 categories, 15 shared (reported; the model is additive, not saturated: it cannot identify an 'autonomous' preference effect)

models_compared: (ii) period + area (additive dummies) - repeated from the audit for comparability
(iii) period + area + building type + style (additive dummies; rare levels pooled as above)
estimation: per embedding dimension, OLS of the L2-normalised CLS of the 600 photographs on intercept + dummies; coefficient matrix B (k x 768); residuals E_res = E - X B. Rank of X reported; if rank-deficient, least-squares minimum-norm solution (numpy lstsq) and the deficiency reported

two_geometries_declared.G1_projection_on_adjusted_direction: u_adj = normalised (mean E_res[A] - mean E_res[C]); outputs are ORIGINAL embeddings projected on u_adj; d_adj = ||mean E_res[A] - mean E_res[C]||; R = mean P / d_adj. This is the geometry of the audit's previous adjustment (outputs cannot be residualised: they have no period/area/type/style). Distances are NOT computed in this geometry because a raw output vs a residualised centroid is not a meaningful distance.
two_geometries_declared.G2_common_linear_transformation: T(e) = (I - Pi) e, where Pi is the orthogonal projector onto the row space of B (the embedding directions along which the covariates shift the photographs, dimension = rank(B) <= k). T is estimated on the photographs only and applied identically to photographs and outputs. In T-space: direction u_T from the transformed photograph centroids, d_T, projections P_T of transformed outputs, R_T = mean P_T / d_T, and distances DeltaD (mean per-image distance to the transformed photograph centroid and centroid-to-centroid), own vs other corpus, own-minus-other. The dimension removed and the share of photograph variance removed are reported. G2 differs from G1: in G2 the outputs are transformed too, so distances are comparable; P and R are reported for both geometries and never mixed.

cells_and_units: 192 prompt x generation-seed cells shared by BASE and the six adapters; contrasts per cell (same prompt, same generation seed); per training seed 1254, 9865, 42160 separately; the mean of the three seeds is a descriptive summary of these six adapters, not an inference about future trainings

uncertainty.conditional_on_direction: bootstrap over the 48 prompts (5000 resamples, seed 20261004, percentile 95%) for every P, R-numerator and DeltaD; R intervals are conditional on d (the denominator is fixed within this bootstrap)
uncertainty.denominator_stability: d (or d_T) re-estimated by resampling the 89 AESTHETIC and 89 CONTROL photographs with replacement (the other 422 fixed), refitting the covariate model and the transformation on the resampled 600 (1000 resamples): quantiles of d_adj reported as a stability check of the denominator ONLY; the bootstrap norm is biased upwards, so these quantiles are not used as a confidence interval of R

reporting: dino_aggiustamento_completo.csv: one row per (direction, geometry, training seed or 'mean of seeds', quantity); columns estimate, ci_low, ci_high, n_cells, denominator, notes. No threshold for 'positive'; estimates and intervals are reported whatever their sign.
what_this_is_not: a linear additive adjustment on recorded catalogue strings; it does not isolate a preference effect from composition, and removing many covariate directions (G2) also removes genuine corpus differences aligned with them: attenuation under G2 is expected by construction and is not evidence against transfer
